screen.stepped_player_animations.title: Stop-Motion Animation
screen.stepped_player_animations.descrip: Global settings for all supported entities
tooltip.stepped_player_animations.enable: Enables or disables stop-motion animation for all entities
tooltip.stepped_player_animations.frame_: Changes the animation frame rate. Higher values make movement smoother
screen.stepped_player_animations.entitie: A checkmark enables stop-motion animation at the global frame rate for this entity type
tooltip.stepped_player_animations.entiti: Enables or disables stop-motion animation for individual entities. You can disable the effect for selected entities or disable it for all of them. Enabled for all entities by default
